description: This file is a locale configuration module for Moment.js, defining localization settings for the Malay language (ms). It includes month and weekday names, date formats, relative time expressions, and calendar settings specific to the Malay locale.

methods.name: defineLocale
methods.description: Method invoked on the 'moment' object to define or override locale settings.

methods.name: meridiemHour
methods.description: Function that adjusts hour based on meridiem indicator (e.g., pagi, tengahari).

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Function to determine the appropriate meridiem label based on the hour.
